## Notable fixes

- The file tree keeps up with the disk: files added, renamed or deleted outside Lattice appear without reopening the project, and Refresh file tree (in the tree's context menu, the Project panel's ⋯ menu and the command palette) rescans on demand without scrolling the list back to the open file.
- A main document inside a subfolder now builds beside itself, so the PDF preview shows its fresh output and jumping between source and PDF works.
